Name: Mesha
ModernLocation: Disputed; proposed locations include Massa (Arabia) and Mesene (Mesopotamia)
Description: The western limit of the Joktanites' dwelling in the Table of Nations, from Mesha as one goes toward Sephar, a mount of the east.
BiblicalSignificance: Mesha marks the edge of Joktan's country, the far boundary of one of Noah's grandsons' families.
